set.body: Represent kernel eigen and Nyström embeddings as their own typed fit artifacts, not as ordinary variable-space projectors. Store landmarks, kernel parameters, centering/normalization rule, eigenvectors, eigenvalues, projection diagnostics, and out-of-sample transform semantics. Acceptance: standard and double Nyström behavior is explicit; all-landmark cases match exact eigensystems; non-finite kernels fail early; new-sample projection tests match multivarious nystrom_embedding fixtures.
set.title: Multivar kernel fits: Nyström and kernel eigen artifacts
